mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both industrial production and housing starts indicates a broad-based contraction in the real economy, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where both INDPRO and HOUST decline by at least 0.5% from their prior month values.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% year-over-year), a rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% signals aggressive monetary tightening that suppresses corporate profits and stock valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high interest rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 900,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening in the residential construction sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of periods where HOUST falls below 900.0 for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past three months indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO declines by at least 0.3% over the prior three months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that accelerates wage growth and inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods where UNRATE falls below 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production above 115.0 for three consecutive months indicates a strong manufacturing sector that boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO rises above 115.0 for three consecutive months.
